{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the population: all customers who converted (converted=1)
converted_data = data[data['converted'] == 1]
n_converted = len(converted_data)
print(f"Number of customers who converted (converted=1): {n_converted}")

# Check how many of them were refunded
refunded_converted = converted_data[converted_data['status'] == 'refunded']
n_refunded = len(refunded_converted)
print(f"Number of converted customers who were refunded: {n_refunded}")

# Examine the age column: exclude -1 as missing
valid_ages = converted_data['customer_age'][converted_data['customer_age'] != -1]
n_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age (not -1): {n_valid_ages}")

# Compute mean age on the full converted population, excluding -1
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
